facts.did: 在 lupanar 二楼坐在两个饿相的辅助兵中间谈生意，坚持要价两倍半（客人只肯两倍）
facts.anchor: sitting between two hungry-looking auxiliary soldiers

facts.did: 看见 Peristyle 后跳起身、穿过拥挤房间走到她面前，说「你回来了」、并说春天她没来时自己很担心
facts.anchor: She jumped up, swirling through the crowded room

facts.did: 对想叫她回去的起哄客人骂「Fuck your own hole, country boy!」并比手势
facts.anchor: Fuck your own hole, country boy!

facts.did: 回答 Peristyle 关于没人修墙的问题：地震后有人搬走、有人还没钱修；Forum 区部分仍在修，很多神庙也一样、祭献改在庭院里做
facts.anchor: Even parts of the Forum district are still closed for repairs

facts.did: 合力从骡车上卸下二十只双耳瓶，小心搬进后屋
facts.anchor: Murtis and Peristyle unloaded twenty amphorae from the cart

facts.did: 邀请两人下周去 Herculaneum 富人 Lucius 的别墅派对，说那里有大量食物酒水、乐队舞蹈和 orgy room
facts.anchor: huge party at this rich patron’s villa in Herculaneum

facts.did: 追问 Lucius 是否就是几年前把一名奴隶献给 Bacchus 的那个人（Hercules 的朋友说他也听过这传闻）
facts.anchor: sacrificed one of his slaves to Bacchus

facts.did: 想到再没有人监督/评判她的文化研究后答应同去，说「Sure, let’s do it.」
